epic.title: Purpose-Aware Installation and Ecosystem Productivity
epic.description: Unify installation purpose, journey orchestration, federation shape, standards readiness, first value, and Hive participation into one coherent path from setup to ecosystem productivity.
epic.scopeRationale: Cross-cutting DPF platform journey spanning installation, Workspace, federation, standards, and Hive.

items.title: Deliver purpose-aware installation to ecosystem productivity
items.body:
## Problem
DPF setup currently treats installations alike even though production, development-companion, managed-service, channel, and community purposes require different federation shapes and paths to value.

## Scope
Coordinate the seven independently shippable slices in the approved design and plan. P0 is complete; P1, R1, P2, P3, P4, and P5 remain.

## Acceptance
- Every child slice ships through its own PR.
- The profile-specific installation journey proves first value and honest ecosystem productivity.
- Existing trust, authority, identity, qualification, and contribution boundaries remain canonical.
- The completion audit in the implementation plan is satisfied.

## Children
BI-A9F60372, BI-91EF130B, BI-4FCBA4B2, BI-1E91D091, BI-AE128860, BI-3E99ACFA, BI-669D2B04.

Plan: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-08-purpose-aware-installation-ecosystem-productivity.md

items.title: Establish the typed installation operating-intent contract and compatibility path
items.body:
## Outcome
One versioned semantic-intent repository plus Contract 12-compliant environment-class capture/projection. Existing installs derive a suggestion but gain no authority or capability.

## Acceptance
- Closed purpose and environment vocabularies are typed and validated.
- Installer state carries environment class and optional bootstrap intent compatibly.
- PlatformConfig persists confirmed semantic intent.
- Existing-install derivation stays suggested until human confirmation.
- Confirmation never mutates federation trust, grants, or capability activation.

Depends on: none.
Delivered by PR #4334: https://github.com/OpenDigitalProductFactory/opendigitalproductfactory/pull/4334

items.title: Build the deterministic journey compiler and productivity projection
items.body:
## Outcome
Generalize the existing activation orchestrator into the single deterministic journey compiler, with profile-specific first-value mission descriptors and evidence-backed readiness.

## Acceptance
- Five purposes × three environment classes compile deterministically.
- Milestones resolve canonical evidence as satisfied, attention, blocked, deferred, or not-applicable.
- Existing activation plans and legacy setup progress remain compatible.
- Productive cannot be returned without the profile's first-value receipt.
- No sibling orchestration substrate is introduced.

Blocked by: BI-A9F60372.
Plan §6: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-08-purpose-aware-installation-ecosystem-productivity.md

items.title: Converge static setup and readiness orchestration
items.body:
## Outcome
One activation/journey package, one setup-progress service, one environment vocabulary, and adapters over existing domain actions.

## Capacity contract
This independently reviewable refactor represents roughly 20% of epic implementation capacity. It removes duplicated orchestration before the UI migration and is not a broad rewrite.

## Acceptance
- Static list-index sequencing is replaced by stable compiler milestones behind a rollback adapter.
- JSON decoding moves into the typed projection service.
- Environment parsing converges on the shared contract.
- Dead setup helpers are removed only after reference and regression proof.
- The diff demonstrates convergence and deletions, not only wrappers.

Blocked by: BI-A9F60372, BI-91EF130B.
Plan §7: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-08-purpose-aware-installation-ecosystem-productivity.md

items.title: Deliver the Workspace purpose and milestone journey companion
items.body:
## Outcome
Workspace becomes the canonical authenticated home for purpose confirmation and milestone progress, without a new navigation area or dashboard.

## Acceptance
- Operators see a bounded purpose recommendation, rationale, correction path, and consequence preview.
- A compact journey companion supports pause/resume and contextual milestones.
- Selection writes intent only; it does not prompt a coworker automatically.
- Error, permission, empty, narrow viewport, keyboard, theme, and branding states are verified.
- The legacy experience remains recoverable during rollout.

Blocked by: BI-A9F60372, BI-91EF130B, BI-4FCBA4B2.
Plan §8: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-08-purpose-aware-installation-ecosystem-productivity.md

items.title: Shape topology and federation orchestration from installation purpose
items.body:
## Outcome
Journey adapters compile appropriate development, managed-service, channel, and community relationship plans while existing federation and partner domains remain the only writers.

## Acceptance
- Profile confirmation changes no link approval, token, grant, contract, or authority field.
- Development companions cannot mutate production directly.
- Managed-estate, sovereign-peer, channel, and community shapes use shared relationship contracts.
- Discovery remains only a candidate until canonical trust and identity evidence exists.
- A2A readiness is consumed from its owning capability rather than synthesized.

Blocked by: BI-A9F60372, BI-91EF130B.
Capability dependencies: BI-BE0E14E0, BI-E2398997.
Plan §9: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-08-purpose-aware-installation-ecosystem-productivity.md

items.title: Prove profile first value and A2A, GAID, TAK, and JSI readiness
items.body:
## Outcome
Each profile proves its first real outcome with honest separation between local A2A readiness, link-scoped same-organization A2A, GAID/AIDoc assurance, TAK, and actual TAK-JSI evidence.

## Acceptance
- Five profile fixtures remain non-productive without their domain outcome and governance receipt.
- Public/general cross-organization assurance is never overclaimed.
- Setup completion alone never implies assessed or qualified.
- TAK/JSI authority ceilings remain fail-closed.
- Unsupported qualification returns required-unavailable with a supervised fallback, not synthetic success.

Blocked by: BI-91EF130B, BI-1E91D091, BI-AE128860.
Capability dependency: BI-BE0E14E0.
Plan §10: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-08-purpose-aware-installation-ecosystem-productivity.md

items.title: Add Hive participation, drift repair, and profile productivity metrics
items.body:
## Outcome
After first value, the installation proves an appropriate learning/participation loop, detects readiness drift, and measures time-to-value by confirmed profile.

## Acceptance
- Contributions reuse existing review, egress, dispatch, result-store, and Hive boundaries.
- Sensitive or non-generalizable findings remain explicitly local-only.
- Evidence drift creates one bounded, actionable repair without resetting onboarding.
- Reconciliation is idempotent and bounded.
- Metrics preserve facets and contain no secrets, raw business values, or peer tokens.

Blocked by: BI-3E99ACFA.
Plan §11: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-08-purpose-aware-installation-ecosystem-productivity.md
